metadata.case_name: CHAN KA LOK v. THE OVERSEAS PLASTIC FACTORY LTD

injuries.description: The palm was lacerated and the bones of the hand were fractured; adhesion in the palm with contractions of the soft tissue preventing proper use of the tendons.
source: The palm was lacerated and the bones of the hand were fractured.

Complete flexion and complete extension are not possible because of adhesion in the palm of the hand with contractions of the soft tissue in that part of the body preventing proper use of the tendons.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: movement of all the fingers from extension to flexion to a total of 30 degrees
complete flexion and complete extension are not possible because of adhesion in the palm preventing proper use of the tendons
combined value of the impairments described by Dr. Mao as a 40% impairment of the whole man

combined value of the impairments described by Dr. Wedderburn as a 38% impairment of the whole man; medical board awarded 35% impairment in August 1983; Dr. Wedderburn described disability related to earning loss as 45%
disability which mars his general activities and enjoyment of life

treatments_future: re-operation by the orthopaedic and plastic surgeons to give the plaintiff a full thickness layer of skin in the palm

losses.description: Disability which mars his general activities and enjoyment of life
